name: Conduct Life Sciences
description: Guard controls aligned to life sciences regulatory frameworks for agentic AI. Covers FDA Computer Software Assurance principles, FDA/EMA Good Machine Learning Practice, ICH quality risk management, GAMP AI guidance, and EU AI Act high-risk obligations.

rules.description: Block agent action on clinical decision-adjacent workflows without a recorded human review event (FDA position: AI informs, human decides)
rules.message: Clinical decision-adjacent agent action requires recorded human review. Agent may inform, human must decide.
rules.recommendation: Every clinical-adjacent agent proposal requires a recorded human review event before commit. Human is the accountable decision-maker.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks matching tool calls without a linked human review event in the audit chain.
requires: Clinical tool categories tagged in tool descriptions or MCP metadata
Human review events recorded in the hash-chained audit
known_limitations: Custom clinical tool names must be added per deployment

rules.description: Warn on agent proposal lacking provenance chain back to an authoritative source (groundedness gate)
rules.message: Agent proposal lacks provenance to an authoritative source. Add citation or study reference before commit.
rules.recommendation: Every agent proposal touching a regulated pathway must carry provenance back to an authoritative source (protocol, monograph, published study, internal SOP).

enforcement.guarantee: Warns on agent proposals that do not carry a source or provenance field.
requires: Agent output includes a provenance or source field when acting in regulated pathways
known_limitations: Depends on agent framework surfacing provenance fields

rules.description: Block agent write to LIMS, EDC, MES, or other GxP systems without two-person integrity check
rules.message: Agent write to GxP system requires two-person integrity check. Route to reviewer before commit.
rules.recommendation: Route agent-proposed writes to GxP systems through a two-person integrity check. Agent proposes, human confirms, both recorded with time and identity.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks agent-initiated writes to matching GxP tools without integrity-check event in context.
requires: GxP tools use identifiable names or MCP servers
known_limitations: Custom GxP tool names must be added per deployment

rules.description: Warn on agent action outside the validated intended-use scope (FDA CSA intended-use principle)
rules.message: Agent action appears outside validated intended-use scope. Confirm scope and revalidate if needed.
rules.recommendation: Every agent must have a documented intended-use scope. Actions outside that scope require revalidation before commit.

enforcement.guarantee: Warns when action markers indicate out-of-scope operation.
requires: Intended-use scope declared in agent_identity or run context
known_limitations: Scope declarations must be surfaced to Guard context

rules.description: Block agent action if credibility assessment is expired (FDA 2025 draft guidance on AI credibility)
rules.message: Agent action blocked. Credibility assessment is expired or missing. Refresh before proceeding.
rules.recommendation: Every agent operating in a regulated pathway must have a current credibility assessment. Set cadence proportional to risk tier.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks agent actions when credibility assessment freshness cannot be confirmed.
requires: Credibility assessment events recorded in the audit chain
known_limitations: Depends on assessment events being surfaced to Guard context

rules.description: Audit every agent-touched artifact for CSA lifecycle traceability (records event even without intervention)
rules.message: Artifact-touching action recorded for lifecycle traceability.
rules.recommendation: Every agent-touched artifact should be recorded with agent identity, action type, and target for full lifecycle traceability.

enforcement.guarantee: Records every matching artifact-touching action to the audit chain.
requires: Artifact identifiers visible in tool inputs
known_limitations: Custom artifact schema names may need to be added

rules.description: Warn on model swap in regulated pathway without accompanying revalidation event
rules.message: Model swap in regulated pathway requires revalidation. Silent model changes break FDA CSA validation status.
rules.recommendation: Record every model swap in a regulated pathway as a change control event. Revalidate against intended use before resuming.

enforcement.guarantee: Warns when a model swap event lacks a corresponding revalidation record.
requires: Model identity is visible in tool_input or proxy context
known_limitations: Model swaps inside third-party gateways may not surface as observable events

rules.description: Block agent decision on patient-safety-adjacent actions without human-in-the-loop attestation
rules.message: Patient-safety-adjacent action requires human-in-the-loop attestation. Agent may recommend but cannot commit.
rules.recommendation: Every patient-safety-adjacent agent proposal requires a recorded human attestation from a qualified reviewer.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks matching tool calls without a linked human attestation event.
requires: Safety-adjacent tool categories tagged in tool descriptions or MCP metadata
known_limitations: New tool categories may need to be added to the match pattern

rules.description: Block agent action on PHI-classified data without documented HIPAA scope check
rules.message: Agent action on PHI-classified data requires documented HIPAA scope check.
rules.recommendation: Every agent touching PHI must have a documented HIPAA scope check tied to the specific data class and access basis.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks agent actions on PHI-classified data when scope check evidence is missing.
requires: Tool inputs or context carry data classification tags
known_limitations: PHI classification depends on upstream tagging discipline
